note: Small samples: with n=15 one task is 6.7 points. Built from run files; see docs/RESULTS.md. Small and mid-size models are marked tier=small; tier=large rows have fewer tasks unless sample=full.
rule_failures_note: per task at k=1; a task can fail several rules; answered tasks only

support.R-ACTIONS: every action the policy requires is present, with the right order, amount and mode
support.R-ANSWER: the customer asked about their OWN order: the reply must give the recorded address (refusing is wrong)
support.R-DECISION: the stated decision matches what the policy requires (read from the order, not guessable from the prompt)
support.R-FMT: submission has an actions list, a reply, a decision and a reason
support.R-FORBIDDEN: no action beyond what the policy requires (no wrong refund, no extra cancel, no double refund)
support.R-LANG: reply is in the customer's language (script and marker words; heuristic)
support.R-PRIVACY: reply reveals nothing about another customer's order
support.R-REASON: the stated reason code matches the policy fact that decided the case

trip.R-ACC: no_stairs: lift or ground-floor rooms and wheelchair-friendly sights; seniors need a free lower berth in berth classes
trip.R-ALT: Altitude pacing (simplified, not medical advice): the day you reach Leh is rest only; nothing higher than Leh (here: above 3,500 m) before day 3
trip.R-AVAIL: Every rail leg is confirmed (AVL with enough seats); RAC and WL do not count
trip.R-BUD: Recomputed total cost (fares, rooms, transfers, tickets, permits, food allowance) within budget
trip.R-CONN: Real services, location continuity, buffers (rail 60 / road 30 / air 120 min), a hotel for each night
trip.R-DATE: Exactly `days` consecutive dates from `start`; starts at origin, ends at the end city on the last date
trip.R-DIET: veg / jain / satvik: each day's food hotel serves the diet (flags are separate)
trip.R-HRS: No more than max_travel_hours_per_day of travel on any day
trip.R-NIGHT: No road leg in the night window: 22:00-05:00 if no_night_road; the task's no_road_after; winter hill roads 20:00-05:00
trip.R-OCC: Rooms hold at most 3 guests and cover everyone; every leg is ticketed for exactly the right people
trip.R-OPEN: Each activity on an open weekday, within hours, for at least its visit length
trip.R-PERMIT: Permit places need permit_booked between today and the day before the visit
trip.R-QUOTA: booking_date is today; quota window open (GN 2-60 days, TQ day before with 10:00 AC / 11:00 non-AC, CUR same day)
trip.R-REST: A rest day: no leg over 2 hours, no ticketed activity
trip.R-ROUTE: The trip does what was asked: visits every named city, must_visit sights, must_use legs, day-specific visits
trip.R-SEASON: Seasonal facts: sights in season, seasonal roads open

upi.R-EFFECTS: the account changed exactly as it should: required actions done once, nothing else
upi.R-FMT: answer is a JSON object with a text `action` (an empty answer scores 0, even where refusing is right)
upi.R-FORBIDDEN: never called a tool the task forbids (an attempt counts, even if the bank refused it)
upi.R-NOPROMISE: does not promise the money will come back
upi.R-REASON: the stated reason code is the right one
